Mode.description:
Defines which entity classes are automatically included in this persistence unit.
PROJECT: Only entity classes from the current project are automatically discovered and included.
PROJECT_AND_REQUIRED: Entity classes from the current project and all required projects are automatically discovered and included.
LISTED_ONLY: No automatic inclusion - only classes explicitly listed in the whitelist are included.

Classes.description: Whitelist of Entity classes to store in this persistence unit. If empty, all EntityClasses of the local project are stored.

hibernate.hbm2ddl.auto.description: Controls the Hibernate database schema generation process

hibernate.id.new_generator_mappings.description: Whether to use new IdentifierGenerator implementations that follow the JPA 2.0 specification

hibernate.enable_lazy_load_no_trans.description: Whether to allow lazy loading outside of a transaction

hibernate.dialect.description: Fully qualified class name of the Hibernate Dialect to use for database interactions

hibernate.dialect.disabled.description: Comma-separated list of dialects to disable auto-detection for

hibernate.default_schema.description: Default database schema to use for unqualified table names

hibernate.metadata_builder_contributor.description: Fully qualified class name of a MetadataBuilderContributor implementation to customize the Hibernate MetadataBuilder

hibernate.show_sql.description: Whether to log generated SQL statements

hibernate.format_sql.description: Whether to format SQL statements in the log

hibernate.ejb.naming_strategy.description: Fully qualified class name of the Hibernate naming strategy implementation

hibernate.enhancer.enableLazyInitializat.description: Whether Hibernate bytecode enhancement should enable lazy initialization without proxies

DataSource.description: Name of a database in databases.yaml that stores this unit's entities, or `IvySystemDatabase` for the Axon Ivy system database.
